title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29613v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. translated_title: 权重编码：通过LLM智能体的直接权重编辑来演化网络规模推荐系统
translated_abstract: 网络规模的推荐模型主要通过重新训练或微调来演化。我们提出了“权重编码”，这是一种通过直接的、可执行的权重编辑来实现模型演化的方法。一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体检查模型结构和参数，提出假设，并利用评估反馈来实施编辑。这一迭代循环从局部修改逐步推进到有针对性的搜索和组合，使被编辑的组件能够相互适应。一个缓存引擎支持无需反向传播的快速前向评估。在Pinterest的1.47亿参数图像搜索双塔召回模型上，权重编码仅通过少量编辑、耗费完整训练后微调约1/4的GPU小时，就将生产模型在留出集上的recall@10提升高达15.0个百分点（相对提升24%），而常规上线通常仅能提升约1%。在随机重新初始化整个1360万参数交互模块的同时保留周围的（摘要截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“权重编码”新方法，利用LLM智能体通过直接、可执行的权重编辑来演化网络规模推荐模型，在Pinterest图像搜索双塔召回器上以仅约1/4的微调成本将recall@10提升高达15个百分点（相对提升24%），远超常规上线的约1%提升。
